description: The 3D Rotation Demo, the example program of Draeden's 1993 tutorial on 3D rotations for VLA, running in your browser.
about: The example program of “Intro To 3d Rotations”, an assembly tutorial Draeden wrote for VLA in 1993, from Grumpy's source pack. F1 to F6 and the 1 and 2 keys change its spin, F7 and F8 its distance.
terms: None found: the tutorial, its source and VLA.NFO state none. Rights holders can reach DosKit's owner below.
